why: Multiple post-snapshot preprints claim to prove non-existence of a perfect cuboid, including a 2025 'divisor-based parameterization' proof, a February 2026 paper using differential algebraic closure, a January 2026 elementary-obstruction paper (arXiv 2602.00239), and an April 2026 'torsion-intersection proof of perfect-cuboid nonexistence on 1,072 explicit master-tuple fibers' (arXiv 2604.28072); none are confirmed as peer-reviewed or accepted.
queries: Euler brick perfect cuboid conjecture new bound
